name: zdeclient_crater_destroy_feature
description: zDEClient_Crater::DestroyFeature frees a crater feature's point array, clip-patch output, and feature object, and ignores null.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zDEClient crater/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x456ad0 validates null no-op, optional free of feature->points, optional zGeometry_ClipPatchOutput::Destroy, and free(feature).
The native zDEClient feature leaf smoke destroys a production-created crater feature and calls DestroyFeature(nullptr).
